title: The Sun is a Star
text: The Sun is actually a star! It's the closest star to Earth. It gives us light and warmth every day.
question: Can you see the Sun at night?

title: Elephants Remember
text: Elephants have very good memories. They can remember where to find water even after many years.
question: What is your favorite animal?

title: Plants Drink Water
text: Plants drink water through their roots, just like you drink through a straw. They also breathe through their leaves!
question: Do you help water plants at home?

title: Where Rain Comes From
text: Clouds are made of tiny water drops. When the drops get heavy, they fall down as rain.
question: Do you like playing in the rain?

title: The Moon
text: The Moon is Earth's neighbor in space. It doesn't make its own light — it reflects the Sun's light.
question: Have you seen the Moon at night?
